mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_session (tenant_id, scene, biz_ref_type, biz_ref_id, status, cli_session_ref, node_id, result_json, error, creator_id, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{scene}, #{bizRefType}, #{bizRefId}, #{status}, #{cliSessionRef}, #{nodeId}, #{resultJson}, #{error}, #{creatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene = #{scene} AND is_deleted = 0 AND biz_ref_id = #{bizRefId} ORDER BY gmt_create DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_session SET cli_session_ref = #{cliSessionRef}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE ai_session SET status = 'FAILED', error = #{error}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version}
